literal.prompt: Какую страницу обычно помещают в начале книги справа; на ней указывают название, автора и издателя?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The manual describes the title page as usually right-hand near the front with title, author and publisher (L1056-1057); it distinguishes the title verso (L1058-1063), contents page (L1116-1124), and index (L1125-1129). This is part of a lesson teaching students to identify book parts (L999-1005).

literalGroups.literal: Титульный лист обычно находится справа в начале книги и содержит её название, имя автора и издателя. На соседней левой странице традиционно размещают титульный оборот с дополнительными сведениями об издании и copyright.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The title-page location and fields are explicit at L1056-1057. The title verso is traditionally the left page immediately after it and contains additional publisher/book details and copyright at L1058-1063.

literalGroups.literal: Слева от него традиционно находится титульный оборот — там приводят дополнительные сведения об издателе и книге, включая copyright.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Extra fact related to the correct page: its traditional left-hand title-verso page follows immediately and contains additional publisher/book details including copyright (L1058-1063).

literalGroups.literal: Он традиционно расположен слева сразу после титульной страницы и содержит дополнительные сведения об издателе и книге.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The title verso is traditionally the left-hand page immediately after the title page and gives more publisher/book information including copyright (L1058-1063).

literalGroups.literal: Она даёт план или краткое описание глав и указывает страницы, на которых они начинаются.
literalGroups.primaryGround: A contents page outlines or summarizes chapters and supplies page numbers so readers can turn to them (L1116-1124).

literalGroups.literal: Он обычно находится в конце книги и перечисляет по алфавиту темы, имена и другие важные понятия с номерами страниц.
literalGroups.primaryGround: An index is usually at the back, lists subjects, people and other important items alphabetically, and gives page references (L1125-1129).

correctNoteNewFact.assessment: The title page’s usual right-hand placement can be learned alongside the separate relation that its traditional left-hand title-verso page follows immediately and contains further publication/copyright information.

entries.absoluteDifficulty: EASY: recognizing a title page and its usual title/author/publisher fields is broad adult book familiarity, not specialist publishing knowledge. The primary source uses “usually”; the proposal preserves the qualifier.

sourceLimitations: Peace Corps source is an educational manual teaching pupils about book parts, not a universal legal or publishing standard; wording retains “usually” and “traditionally.”
LoC CIP output was Internal Error and is not used.
